metadata.agent_last_message:
Implemented a std-only Rust (edition 2021) BibTeX-compatible CLI as a Cargo project under `output/` (entry point `output/src/main.rs:1`).

Build/run:
- `cargo build --release --manifest-path output/Cargo.toml`
- `cargo run --release --manifest-path output/Cargo.toml -- --bib refs.bib --style plain.bst --cites cites.txt --output out.bbl --log run.log.json`
  - Or use `--aux paper.aux` (you can pass both `--cites` and `--aux`; cites are concatenated then deduped case-insensitively).

Behavior:
- Exit `0`: writes `.bbl` to `--output` (LF newlines, 79-col wrapping like BibTeX).
- Exit `1`: writes error JSON to `--output` (and still writes `--log` if requested).
- Exit `2`: unexpected internal error (panic caught).
